summary: The added `_def` lemmas and the private helpers are the right shape, but the new public relations spell the Cartan entry differently from the already-merged Cartan-action lemmas of the same family, and the now-complete set of Serre inputs is left unpackaged, so no consumer can state the type-B Serre system without re-bridging conventions.
